title: Display per-step timing in iteration header
description: Track start time at the beginning of each iteration and display elapsed time when the iteration ends. Show timing in yellow below or beside the iteration header.
acceptanceCriteria: Each completed iteration shows elapsed time (e.g., '⏱ 45s') in yellow
Timing appears after the iteration header bar

steps.description: Yield timing events from loop runner
steps.details: Already handled in TASK-61. Ensure timing events include iteration number and elapsed milliseconds.

steps.description: Display timing in IterationHeader or below it
steps.details: Update IterationHeader or add a TimingLine component below it: <Text color='yellow'>⏱ {formatTime(elapsedMs)}</Text>. Only show when elapsed time is available (after iteration completes).
In RocketLoopApp, store iterationTimings as an array. Update it when timing events are received from the loop runner.
